== Ingredients ==

* Large mesquite chunks, as needed
* 1 [[Cookbook:Each|ea]]. (8–10 [[Cookbook:Pound|lb]]) beef [[Cookbook:Beef#Brisket|brisket]]
* ½ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] vinegar mixture from [[Cookbook:North Carolina-Style BBQ Ribs|North Carolina-Style BBQ Ribs]], plus more for serving
* ¼ cup [[Cookbook:Worcestershire Sauce|Worcestershire sauce]]
* ¼ cup [[Cookbook:Honey|honey]]
* 1 cup [[Cookbook:Dijon Mustard|Dijon mustard]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] [[Cookbook:Barbecue Rub|Barbecue Rub]]
* Hamburger buns for serving

== Procedure ==
#Place mesquite into the firebox of a 250°F smoker.
#Trim fat cap to ¼ [[Cookbook:Inch|inch]]. Place brisket into a large [[Cookbook:Aluminium Foil|foil]] pouch and pour in vinegar mixture, Worcestershire sauce, and honey. Place pouch in smoker and cook for 6 hours, changing chunks as needed.
#Remove brisket from pouch, spread mustard evenly on it, and massage Rub into meat. Place brisket back into smoker and cook for 10 hours, changing chunks as needed.
#Separate brisket halves along fat line. Slice across the grain as thinly as humanly possible, chop roughly, and place serving portion in halved buns. 
#Place some vinegar mixture into a squirt bottle and serve with sandwiches.
